items.title: Define Story Capsule contract and storage APIs
items.context: Add capsule.json, session-brief.md, handoff.md and story-scoped capsule directory under configured storyDir; no-capsule session_brief must degrade cleanly.
items.userSees: koala capsule_show --story B-42c0 prints a JSON/markdown capsule summary from .koala/story/actives/B-42c0/capsule, while a story with no capsule prints a clear no capsule yet message.

happy.desc: Create/read capsule contract under configured storyDir and render basic summary.

edge.desc: Story without capsule returns graceful empty state without throwing.

adversarial.desc: Fixture with storyDir=.koala/story/actives proves implementation does not hardcode docs/story or Docs/story.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke creates and reads capsule.json under configured storyDir and renders a capsule summary.
Smoke verifies capsule_show returns a graceful no-capsule message before capsule creation.
Smoke uses storyDir=.koala/story/actives and asserts no hardcoded docs/story capsule path is created.

items.title: Record run summaries and metrics under capsule/runs
items.context: Add run.json, transcript.md, metrics.json, artifacts.json support with provider/role/result/commands/evidence/process-event references while avoiding full chat transcript persistence.
items.userSees: koala capsule_run_add records a run and koala capsule_show shows Last run: implementer/pass with command, role, provider, evidence refs, and metrics summary.

happy.desc: capsule_run_add persists run.json, transcript.md, metrics.json, and artifacts.json for a valid checklist run.

edge.desc: Long transcript input is summarized/truncated rather than stored as full chat by default.

adversarial.desc: Invalid checklistId/storyId run add is rejected and does not leave partial run files.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke verifies capsule_run_add persists run.json, transcript.md, metrics.json, and artifacts.json for a valid checklist run.
Smoke feeds a long transcript and asserts transcript.md contains a truncation marker rather than the full input.
Smoke verifies invalid checklistId is rejected by capsule_run_add.

items.title: Connect capsule projection to process-events and rebuild
items.context: Emit capsule_updated, handoff_written, run_metrics_recorded events and add a rebuild path so capsule.json can be regenerated from process-events plus evidence.
items.userSees: After deleting capsule/capsule.json, koala capsule_update --rebuild restores a baseline capsule and process-events.jsonl contains capsule_updated or handoff_written audit lines.

happy.desc: Capsule mutations append capsule_updated/handoff/run events to process-events.jsonl.

edge.desc: Rebuild works when capsule.json is missing but story/checklist/process-events exist.

adversarial.desc: Rebuild does not mutate or rewrite existing process-events ledger lines.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts capsule_updated, handoff_written, and run_metrics_recorded are appended to process-events.jsonl.
Smoke deletes capsule.json and verifies capsule_update rebuild recreates the projection from story/checklist/process-events.
Smoke captures the first process-events ledger line and verifies rebuild does not rewrite it.

items.title: Productize capsule CLI and session_brief integration
items.context: Add capsule_show, capsule_update, capsule_handoff, capsule_run_add and ensure koala session_brief renders Current Story Capsule without becoming noisy.
items.userSees: koala help lists capsule_show/capsule_update/capsule_handoff/capsule_run_add/capsule_import_omx, and koala session_brief displays a compact Current Story Capsule block for the active story.

happy.desc: New capsule commands are registered, have command policies, handlers, and process-fact levels.

edge.desc: session_brief remains concise and does not show noisy capsule blocks when no capsule exists.

adversarial.desc: Command ownership and process fact contract tests fail if any new command is unclassified.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lifecycle-registry-contract && npm run test:process-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Contract tests verify new capsule commands have handlers, ownership policy, phase availability, and process-fact levels.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:story-capsule-smoke && npm run test:session-brief
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke verifies session_brief renders capsule block when present and graceful no-capsule reads stay concise; session brief command-center test still passes.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm run test:process-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Contract tests fail closed for unclassified commands and verify capsule_* are registered in process facts.

items.title: Bind capsule references to evidence and gate diagnostics
items.context: Validate evidenceRefs/processEventRefs exist; forged session-brief.md cannot satisfy DONE and missing refs fail or warn according to command/gate context.
items.userSees: A forged capsule/session-brief.md saying all done still produces a capsule validation warning/error for missing evidence refs, and story_advance DONE remains blocked by the normal evidence gates.

happy.desc: Valid evidenceRefs and processEventRefs resolve against story files and process-events.

edge.desc: Read-only display shows missing references clearly without crashing.

adversarial.desc: Forged session-brief.md or capsule text cannot satisfy DONE or evidence coverage without real refs.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:story-capsule-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts valid evidenceRef+processEventRef shows Ref health: ok after capsule_update with matching checklist intentRef and correct process-event line/type.
Smoke asserts non-strict capsule_show with a missing evidence path shows the error text in output without crashing.
Smoke forges session-brief.md with all-done prose then asserts strict capsule_show still reports capsule refs invalid because validation reads capsule.json not session-brief.md.

items.title: Add non-authoritative OMX import and complete tests
items.context: Implement capsule_import_omx as explicit non-authoritative import, keep .omx optional, and add smoke/contract tests for all new commands, rebuild, session_brief output, and fake evidence resistance.
items.userSees: koala capsule_import_omx reports source=omx_import authority=non_authoritative when .omx exists, and reports no OMX context found without failing when .omx is absent.

happy.desc: capsule_import_omx imports bounded .omx context/log/metrics summaries with non_authoritative metadata.

edge.desc: Import command succeeds with a clear no-op message when .omx is absent.

adversarial.desc: Imported OMX material is display-only and never counted as lifecycle gate evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Original OMX import intent is permanently superseded by the user scope change to delete the .omx capsule application; smoke now verifies capsule_import_omx is unavailable and capsule keeps no importRefs.
Original missing-.omx no-op import intent is superseded by removal; the supported edge is that .omx may exist locally but no capsule imports directory or importRefs are created.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:story-capsule-smoke && npm run test:process-fact-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lifecycle-registry-contract && npm run test:session-brief && npm test
verificationEvidence.note: Tests prove the .omx import command is removed from the CLI/policy/process-fact surface, strict capsule validation still rejects authoritative capsule evidence, and current capsule projection has no importRefs.

items.title: Enforce capsule retention and anti-duplication boundary
items.context: Keep Story Capsule as a bounded handoff note instead of a second story history. Limit run/import/process-event refs, cap prose length, and warn/fail in strict mode when capsule tries to carry full lifecycle history.
items.userSees: koala capsule_show reports bounded capsule counts and strict mode rejects oversized/ref-history capsules; capsule remains a projection instead of a duplicate story log.

happy.desc: Adding more than the retained run/import/process-event references keeps capsule current state bounded while preserving older run files/artifacts.

edge.desc: summary and nextAction are bounded so capsule cannot become a long historical transcript.

adversarial.desc: capsule_show --strict rejects an oversized capsule or authoritative imported/capsule evidence reference instead of treating it as lifecycle truth.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:story-capsule-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke adds more run/import/process-event references than the retention limits and verifies capsule keeps bounded current refs while preserving older run/import artifacts.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:story-capsule-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke writes oversized summary and nextAction through capsule_update and verifies stored fields are bounded by CAPSULE_LIMITS.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:story-capsule-smoke && npm run test:process-fact-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lifecycle-registry-contract && npm run test:session-brief
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke forges oversized and authoritative capsule/import references and verifies capsule_show --strict rejects them; contract tests confirm command policy/session behavior stays valid.
